description: This file defines a set of data structures, classes, and fields related to association request frames in a Wi-Fi protocol context, using YAML syntax to specify TLV (Type-Length-Value) structures, references to external headers, and enumerations specific to association parameters.

classes.name: cSSID
classes.description: Represents the SSID element, a class TLV structure with a type of ID_SSID and a variable-length string of max 32 characters.

classes.name: cRSN
classes.description: Represents the RSN element containing the RSNE details, including version and optional parameters, indicated by comments.

classes.name: cSupportedOpClasses
classes.description: Represents supported operation classes, including current operation class and list of op classes.

classes.name: cSupportRates
classes.description: Includes supported rates and BSS membership selectors; not present if specific options are implemented.

classes.name: cExtendedSupportRates
classes.description: Contains extended supported rates and bonuses, conditionally present based on implementation flags.

classes.name: cPowerCapability
classes.description: Defines power capability with min and max transmit power levels, conditionally present.

classes.name: cBssCoexistence20_40
classes.description: Contains coexistence information relevant for 20/40 MHz operation.

classes.name: cQosTrafficCap
classes.description: Indicates QoS traffic capabilities along with traffic class info.

classes.name: cTimBroadcastRequest
classes.description: Represents TIM broadcast request parameters including interval.

classes.name: cInterworking
classes.description: Interworking element with options for network options and optional parameters.

classes.name: cMultiBand
classes.description: Multi-band control structure with band ID, channel info, BSSID, and various operational parameters.

classes.name: eMultiBandId
classes.description: Enumeration of band identifiers including 2.4GHz, 3.6GHz, 5GHz, etc.

classes.name: cDmgCapabilities
classes.description: DMG specific capabilities including BSSID, aid, and various DMG features.

classes.name: cMultipleMacSublayers
classes.description: Structure supporting multiple MAC sublayers, with associated MAC addresses and control flags.

classes.name: cOperatingModeNotify
classes.description: Notification structure for operating mode changes.

classes.name: cVendorSpecific
classes.description: Vendor-specific data element with OUI and data payload.

classes.name: cUnknownField
classes.description: Placeholder class for unknown or unhandled IEs, storing raw data.
